newsitem.title: USA: Stock fund flows slip in 3-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: Stock fund flows slip in 3-day period - survey.

text.p: Flows into stock mutual funds slipped to $41 million for the three-day period ended Nov 14, compared with $430 million for the previous two-day period ended November 11, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
The fund-tracking firm said flows into U.S. stock funds were $90 million versus $474 million, while international stock funds had outflows of $49 million versus outflows of $44 million.
Flows into aggressive growth dropped to $26 million from $132 million, and growth funds had outflows of $128 million versus inflows of $180 million.
Flows into bond funds edged off to $50 million from $66 million. Government/GNMA funds had outflows of $82 million versus inflows of $8 million.
Muni funds narrowed outflows to $1 million from $39 million.
